subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: ⎯⎯ The rapid growth of population must be controlled. (a) all sorts of attempts to solve food problem will fail. (b) ⎯⎯, we have to increase our food production very rapidly. We may mostly, solve our food problem by changing our habit. (c) ⎯⎯ , we can take potato instead of rice. (d) ⎯⎯ it is high time we changed our eating habit. (e) ⎯⎯, knowledge of nutritive value of food can help to solve our food problem to a great extent.
guide_solution: (a) Otherwise (b) At the same time (c) For instance (d) So (e) Last of all
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Dhaka Board-2020 (Board Question With Solution)
flag_note: Gap letters in question ['b', 'c', 'd', 'e'] differ from solution letters ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'].
